{{Quote|My master's master told me about the ''Hundred-Year Darkness''&hellip; and the Great ''Hyperspace War''. He taught me how the agents of the ''dark side'' do their evil works.|Shayoto|<ref name="DLotS3" />}}
An '''individual''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|member]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who lived for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]. He witnessed the conflicts known as the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]] and the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. The long-lived individual eventually [[Jedi training/Legends|instructed]] [[Shayoto's master|another Jedi]], who in turn taught the Jedi [[Shayoto]], to whom the former imparted knowledge of the general principles under which adherents of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] operated.

==Biography==
{{Quote|My master also lived ''many'' centuries, and his master before him.|Shayoto|<ref name="DLotS3" />}}
[[File:Shayoto.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The long-lived Jedi eventually imparted some knowledge to his apprentice's apprentice, Shayoto (pictured).]]
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual served as a [[Jedi/Legends|member]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and lived for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] prior to the [[Krath Holy Crusade]]<ref name="DLotS3" /> of [[3997 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> He witnessed both the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]],<ref name="DLotS3" /> a century-long war against the [[Exiles|Dark Jedi who would become the first Sith Lords]] that lasted from [[7000 BBY]] to [[6900 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]],<ref name="DLotS3" /> a war against the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] that occured in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> The long-lived Jedi eventually [[Jedi training/Legends|instructed]] [[Shayoto's master|another Jedi]], who in turn taught the Jedi [[Shayoto]], with the latter two also going on to live for hundreds of [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="DLotS3" />

The teacher of Shayoto's Jedi instructor at one point imparted to Shayoto the knowledge of the general principles under which adherents of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] operated&mdash;which included the secret corruption of the leaders of various societies followed by sudden strikes that vanquished eons-old civilizations.<ref name="DLotS3" /> In 3997 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> at the Jedi [[Conclave at Deneba|conclave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Deneba/Legends|Deneba]] that sought to address the growing threat of the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] cult of darksiders, Shayoto recalled those teachings while addressing the gathering.<ref name="DLotS3" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi was introduced in the [[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 3|third issue]] of [[Dark Horse Comics]]' [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - Dark Lords of the Sith'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] mini-series. The issue was authored by [[Tom Veitch]] and [[Kevin J. Anderson]]<ref name="DLotS3" /> and published on [[December 13]], [[1994]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54573/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_dark_lords_of_the_sith_1994_3|text=Star Wars: Tales Of The Jedi - Dark Lords Of The Sith (1994) #3}}</ref> In the [[1997]] [[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|audio dramatization]] of ''Dark Lords of the Sith'', Shayoto's lines are instead erroneously delivered by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arca Jeth]], and the line of long-lived individuals including this Jedi is not mentioned.<ref name="DLotSaudio">[[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith'' audio drama]]</ref>
